candidates.evidence: I give you divine sight, so you may behold my supreme power
revealed to Arjuna the supreme divine form
You cannot see me with these ordinary eyes

angle_en: Divine sight and the supreme form

en.intro: After Krishna grants Arjuna divine sight to see beyond the physical, what does Arjuna witness? Listen to Sanjaya's account of the revelation.
en.notice: Sanjaya tells Dhritarashtra that the great lord of yoga, Hari, reveals to Partha the supreme divine form, the very cosmic reality Arjuna asked to see.
en.next: Sanjaya then describes the many mouths, eyes, and divine weapons on this form.
en.meaning: Sanjaya says: Having spoken thus, O King, the great lord of yoga, Hari, revealed to Arjuna the supreme divine form.

hi.intro: कृष्ण द्वारा दिव्य दृष्टि दिए जाने के बाद, अर्जुन क्या देखता है? सुनिए संजय का वर्णन उस विराट रूप का।
hi.meaning: संजय कहते हैं, हे राजन्, ऐसा कहकर फिर महायोगेश्वर भगवान् श्रीकृष्णने अर्जुनको परम ऐश्वररूप दिखाया।
hi.notice: संजय धृतराष्ट्र को बताते हैं कि योगेश्वर हरि ने पार्थ को अपना परम ऐश्वररूप दिखाया, वही दिव्य सत्य जो अर्जुन ने देखने के लिए कहा था।
hi.next: संजय फिर उस रूप के अनेक मुख, नेत्रों और दिव्य अस्त्रों का वर्णन करते हैं।

issues: wrong_fact: "Sanjaya then describes the many mouths, eyes, and divine weapons on this terrifying form." (This is the content of the NEXT verse (verse 10), not this verse (verse 9). It misattributes the description of the many mouths, eyes, and weapons to the current verse, which only states that the supreme form was revealed.)
